mapper.select: SELECT CONCAT('', 'Staff Payroll Summary for ', DATE_FORMAT(#{filter.date}, "%M %Y")) AS title, DATE_FORMAT(#{filter.date}, "%M %Y") AS currentMonth, (SELECT DATE_FORMAT(DATE_ADD(#{filter.date}, INTERVAL -1 MONTH), "%M %Y")) AS previousMonth

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(total_amount),0) FROM payrolls WHERE is_active = 1 AND employee_id IN (SELECT id FROM employees WHERE is_active = 1 AND department_id = #{departmentId} AND paid_by = 1 AND MONTH(pay_date) = MONTH(#{date}) AND YEAR(pay_date) = YEAR(#{date})) AND ( employee_id IN ( SELECT employee_id FROM employee_apply_status AS eas WHERE eas.is_active = 1 AND eas.employee_status_id NOT IN(4,5,6) ) OR employee_id IN ( SELECT employee_id FROM employee_apply_status AS eas WHERE eas.is_active = 1 AND eas.employee_status_id IN (4,5,6) AND MONTH(eas.date) > MONTH(#{date}) AND YEAR(eas.date) >= YEAR(#{date}) ) OR employee_id IN ( SELECT employee_id FROM payrolls WHERE is_active = 1 AND employee_id = employee_id AND MONTH(pay_date) = MONTH(#{date}) AND YEAR(pay_date) = YEAR(#{date}) ) ) -- AND employee_id NOT IN (SELECT employee_id FROM employee_apply_status WHERE is_active = 1 AND employee_status_id = 4 AND payroll_type = 2)

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(total_amount),0) FROM payrolls WHERE is_active = 1 AND employee_id IN (SELECT id FROM employees WHERE is_active = 1 AND department_id = #{departmentId} AND paid_by = 2 AND MONTH(pay_date) = MONTH(#{date}) AND YEAR(pay_date) = YEAR(#{date})) AND ( employee_id IN ( SELECT employee_id FROM employee_apply_status AS eas WHERE eas.is_active = 1 AND eas.employee_status_id NOT IN(4,5,6) ) OR employee_id IN ( SELECT employee_id FROM employee_apply_status AS eas WHERE eas.is_active = 1 AND eas.employee_status_id IN (4,5,6) AND MONTH(eas.date) > MONTH(#{date}) AND YEAR(eas.date) >= YEAR(#{date}) ) OR employee_id IN ( SELECT employee_id FROM payrolls WHERE is_active = 1 AND employee_id = employee_id AND MONTH(pay_date) = MONTH(#{date}) AND YEAR(pay_date) = YEAR(#{date}) ) ) -- AND employee_id NOT IN (SELECT employee_id FROM employee_apply_status WHERE is_active = 1 AND employee_status_id = 4 AND payroll_type = 2)
